# The WESTIN Residence Gurugram

> The WESTIN Residence by Marriott is a branded luxury residential development in Sector 103, Gurugram, located on the Dwarka Expressway. This website, https://www.thewestinresidences.co/, is operated by authorized channel partners for informational purposes and is not the official website of the developer.

## Project Overview

The WESTIN Residence by Marriott offers ultra-luxury 3 BHK and 4 BHK residences in Sector 103, Gurugram. The development is part of a 20-acre master-planned community designed around luxury, wellness, sustainability, recreation, and nature.

* Project: The WESTIN Residence by Marriott
* Location: Sector 103, Gurugram, Haryana, India
* Connectivity: Dwarka Expressway
* Project status: New Launch
* Residential configurations: 3 BHK and 4 BHK
* Pricing: shared on request through the authorised channel partner
* 3 BHK sizes advertised: approximately 2,673–2,939 sq. ft.
* 4 BHK sizes advertised: approximately 3,750–4,328 sq. ft.
* Community size: 20 acres
* Developer information: Whiteland
* Brand: WESTIN / Marriott

## Floor Plans

Detailed floor plan page: https://www.thewestinresidences.co/westin-residences-floor-plan.html

Five layouts, saleable / carpet / balcony area in sq ft, with tower allocation:

* 3 BHK Small — 2,673 / 1,431 / 431 — Towers 1, 2, 3, 4, 4A, 4B
* 3 BHK Large — 2,939 / 1,577 / 482 — Towers 2, 3, 4, 4A
* 4 BHK Small — 3,750 / 1,969 / 318 — Towers 7, 8, 9
* 4 BHK Medium — 3,987 / 2,095 / 376 — Towers 5, 6
* 4 BHK Large — 4,328 / 2,211 / 585 — Towers 5, 6

Phase 1 (Towers 2, 3, 4, 4A, 4B; 848 homes) carries a RERA completion date of 30 September 2031.

## Payment Plan

The website currently presents the following indicative payment schedule:

* On booking: 9%
* Within 45 days from booking: 11%
* Within 75 days from booking: 10%
* Within 120 days of booking or commencement of excavation, whichever is later: 5%
* On completion of the 20th floor slab: 15%
* On completion of the superstructure: 15%
* On application for Occupation Certificate (OC): 25%
* On offer of possession: 10%

Buyers should verify the latest payment plan and contractual terms before making any investment decision.

## Location

The WESTIN Residence is located in Sector 103, Gurugram, along the Dwarka Expressway.

The website highlights:

* Strategic location between Delhi and Gurugram
* Access to Dwarka Expressway
* Approximately 10 minutes from IGI Airport, NH8, and Hero Honda Chowk, according to the website
* DPS School and an international hospital already operational in Sector 103
* Approximately 100 acres of green area adjoining Sector 103
* Sector 103 described as the largest residential sector planned on the Dwarka Expressway

Travel times are indicative and may vary depending on traffic and route conditions.

## Amenities

The WESTIN Residence is designed around luxury living, wellness, recreation, convenience, and hospitality-style services.

Amenities and facilities highlighted on the website include:

* Olympic-sized swimming pool
* Heated swimming pool with dedicated lap lanes
* State-of-the-art fitness center
* Dedicated yoga studio
* Secure underground covered parking
* Electric vehicle charging stations
* Landscaped gardens
* Walking paths
* 24/7 security
* CCTV surveillance
* Hospitality-style services
* Clubhouse
* Wellness, recreation, and dining facilities

## Design

The project website identifies the following design consultants:

* Architecture: Architect Hafeez Contractor
* Interior design: BM&A / Bobby Mukherji & Associates
* Landscaping: Coopers Hill

## Project Concept

The WESTIN Residence Gurugram is positioned as a wellness-oriented luxury residential development. The project incorporates sustainability and biophilic architectural concepts intended to strengthen residents' connection with nature.

The clubhouse is described as a major component of the development, with amenities focused on wellness, recreation, and dining.
